content.title: The Cast of 'Beef' Season 2 Boasts Stars from 'Parasite,' 'Minari,' and More
content.text: Beef season 2 - official trailer (Netflix)Digital Spy GBLIVECurrent Time 0:00Total Duration 1:263 min readAfter Beef became a breakout hit in 2023 and won multiple Emmys, the series is back with an entirely new story. Season 2 trades its intimate, two-person spiral for a layered chain reaction between two couples (and the people around them) navigating power, class, and wealth against the backdrop of an elite country club.This time around, the tension begins when a younger couple witnesses a volatile moment between their employers, which quickly entangles everyone in a toxic, inescapable feud.Beef season 2 is now streaming on Netflix as of April 16. Here’s a closer look at the cast bringing this new chapter to life.Oscar Isaac as JoshNetflixIsaac leads the season as Josh, a country club manager whose personal life becomes the catalyst for the story’s central conflict. When a heated argument with his wife spirals out of control, it doesn’t stay private for long, and he has to face the consequences.Isaac is known for his wide-ranging film work, including Dune, Frankenstein, and Ex-Machina. He has previously appeared in series like Scenes from a Marriage and Moon Knight. Carey Mulligan as LindsayNetflixAdvertisement - Continue Reading BelowMulligan plays Lindsay, Josh’s wife, whose strained marriage becomes impossible to ignore after a particularly explosive confrontation. As their relationship unravels, it sets off a ripple effect that reaches far beyond their home.Mulligan has appeared in films including Maestro and The Great Gatsby.Charles Melton as AustinNetflixMelton stars as Austin, one half of the younger couple whose lives shift after witnessing Josh and Lindsay’s fight. Alongside his partner, Ashley, Austin works at the country club and becomes entangled in the escalating situation involving their employers.Melton is best known for his roles in May December and Riverdale.Cailee Spaeny as AshleyNetflixSpaeny plays Ashley, Austin’s fiancée and an employee at Josh’s country club. After witnessing the incident between Josh and Lindsay, Ashley becomes increasingly aware of the fragile power dynamics at play—both at work and in her own relationship.Spaeny has appeared in films including Priscilla, Civil War, and Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery.Youn Yuh-jung as Chairwoman ParkNetflixAdvertisement - Continue Reading BelowYoun Yuh-jung takes on the role of Chairwoman Park, the billionaire owner of the country club where much of the story unfolds. As the most powerful figure in this environment, Park becomes a central force in the unfolding drama, with multiple characters seeking her approval—and influence.Youn is widely recognized for her Oscar-winning performance in Minari, as well as her work in Pachinko.Song Kang-ho as Dr. KimNetflixSong Kang-ho plays Dr. Kim, Chairwoman Park’s husband and a key figure within her inner circle. As tensions build across the club’s social hierarchy, their marriage adds another layer to the season’s exploration of power and partnership.Song is known for acclaimed films including Parasite and Memories of Murder.Seoyeon Jang as EuniceNetflixJang plays Eunice, an employee of Chairwoman Park who works with Austin and Ashley. The Korean-British actress has previously starred in Prime Video’s Butterfly, and Korean series like Doctor Lawyer, Love Is for Suckers, and Good Partner.William Fichtner as TroyNetflixFichtner appears as Troy, a wealthy member of the country club who has a close relationship with Josh. The actor’s previous credits include Prison Break, Crash, Armageddon, and more.Mikaela Hoover as AvaNetflixHoover plays Ava, another member of the club whose role intersects with Lindsay and Ashley.
